thread:
jamie: Heads-up: I'm about to change HPA target CPU from 60% -> 50% for web-prod. Also wiring a new secret path for the metrics adapter. Quick review please?
omar: What's the reason for 50%? saw a spike earlier — are you switching to targetAverageValue or targetAverageUtilization?
jamie: targetAverageUtilization -> 50. goal is to reduce tail latency caused by autoscale lag, pods were slow to catch up during traffic burst.
katie: Make sure metrics-server isn't returning NaNs. Also consider adding podAnnotations for prometheus scraping so adapter has stable metrics. Can you paste the HPA + terraform snippet you're changing?
jamie: Sure — HPA snippet: ```apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: web
  minReplicas: 3
  maxReplicas: 40
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 50``` And Terraform secret change (short): ```resource "kubernetes_secret" "prom_adapter_creds" {
  metadata { name = "prom-adapter-creds" namespace = "kube-system" }
  data = { config.yml = filebase64("${path.module}/prom-config.yml") }
}```
omar: For the TF secret, prefer creating in `ingress` namespace as well (some components read from there). Update deployment to `envFrom: secretRef: name: prom-adapter-creds`. Also double-check RBAC for prometheus-adapter SA.
jamie: deploy-bot: planning deploy to staging in 15m. infra-bot: can you run a quick secret rotation check for both namespaces?
infra-bot: Rotation check: secret exists in kube-system and ingress, last rotated 24h ago — ok. Found missing ClusterRoleBinding for prometheus-adapter in staging, opening PR to add minimal read metrics role.
katie: Small Karpenter ask: can we disable consolidation on the staging provisioner while running the scale test? e.g., add `karpenter.sh/consolidation: disabled` annotation so nodes don't get consolidated mid-test.
jamie: I'll add `karpenter.sh/consolidation: "disabled"` to staging provisioner for the test. Also note VPA is set to Off for web-prod — don't enable VPA while HPA manages CPU.
omar: LGTM. One more question: are we using custom metrics via prometheus-adapter or external metrics? If we use external (queue length) for workers we need `external` metric config.
katie: :thumbsup: I can review the PR once it's up. FYI I ran `kubectl top nodes` earlier — nodes avg CPU ~40% so 50% target seems safe.
jamie: Thanks all. I'll open the PR with the Terraform + HPA manifest and link it here in ~10m.
summary: Coordination on lowering HPA CPU target, Terraform secret placement, Karpenter consolidation toggle, and metrics adapter RBAC + checks
